# Descriptions
@@ 1
A beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster’s palm; 50'
effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;”
when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the spell
duration has not expired).
@@ 2
Lights a 10 foot radius area about the point touched; if the point is on a
mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being.
@@ 3
Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 10 from all attacks against the target.
@@ 4
As Light I, except 1 or 2 areas can be created with a total radius of 20'
(e.g., one area of 20' or two areas of 10').
@@ 5
Causes a 10 foot radius burst of intense light, all within are stunned for 1
round per 10 failure.
@@ 6
As Aura, except it makes him appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from all
attacks against the target.
@@ 7
A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results
are determined on the Shock Bolt Attack Table 13.8 (p. 87).
@@ 8
As Light II, up to 3 areas can be created with a total radius of 30'.
@@ 9
As Light I, except it is the equivalent of full daylight; it also nullifies
all magically created darkness for the duration.
@@ 10
As Light I, except caster can delay the spell up to 24 hours; it can be
triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): elapsed time, specific
movements, specific sounds, or touch.
@@ 11
A 6'' radius ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel
to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as
a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area equal to the range is lit
if the flare can raise to its full range. If used against a target, use the
Shock Bolt Attack Table 13.8 (p. 87) but deliver Heat criticals.
@@ 13
As Light III, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of 50'.
@@ 15
As Light III, except up to 10 areas can be created with a total radius of
100'.
@@ 17
As Utterlight I, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of
50'.
@@ 18
As Light III, except total radius is 10' per level.
@@ 20
As Aura, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 25
Caster can cause a lightning bolt to strike a target within his range. Results
are determined on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table. There must be a storm
within 1 mile that is severe enough to cause precipitation or lightning or
very heavy winds. The caster must be outdoors to cast this spell.
@@ 30
As Aura, except target seems like a minor god and the subtraction is 25.
@@ 50
As Utterlight I, except as many areas as the caster levels can be created with
a total radius of 10' per level.
